name: PT Pyridam Farma Tbk
summary: PT Pyridam Farma Tbk engages in the pharmaceutical business in Australia, Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore, and India. The company operates through two segments, Pharmaceutical Products, Esthetic and Toll Manufacturing Services; and Medical Equipment segments. It supplies medical instruments and equipment, including clinical waste, collection swab, collection tube, innerbox DCA, KF94 mask, parafilm, PCR - extraction kit and extractor machine, speciment bag, sterile container, PCR machine- Gentier 48, and tube stopper.
